input: Find half-day and morning-only summer camps for young kids (ages 3-6) for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Johnson City summer camps 2025 preschool dance gymnastics morning

candidates.name: Corylace Cove
candidates.note: 2026 nature camps for ages 3–5 and craft camps for ages 4–16; younger groups have shortened days.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: 2025 coed soccer camp for ages 5–15 offered a half-day option starting at 9 a.m.; also runs other sports and arts programs.

candidates.name: Into the Fire
candidates.note: 2026 art camps for ages 5 and up met Tuesday–Friday, 9–11:30 a.m., with pottery and other craft projects.

candidates.name: Johnson City Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 Princess Ballerina Camp: weeklong half-day program for girls ages 3–8 with singing, dancing and creative play.
